theorem.name: MinimalLeafFillRouteSelection
theorem.statement: Given the current repository state, the finite quotient identity route is strictly the smaller next gate for oriented Phi_fin threshold closure. The smooth E_Qa route remains legal but demands an entire smooth source, operator, and regularization payload. The finite route instead asks for one same-branch source theorem identifying the already built oriented 27-mode B_N table as the selected heterotic Qa/SU3 threshold quotient, with a trace finitepart identity and no-double-count policy.
